'''2012 European Championship Pär Birgander LS We'll Handle This (V)''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Pär Birgander]] at [[2012 European Championship]] (European Championship).


== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' [[We'll Handle This (V) / Duel Of The Fates (V)]]
* '''Username:''' pbira
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' European Championship
